### January 01, 2026 to January 23, 2026

<details>

Happy New Year! 🎆 The Flutter team and community have kicked off 2026 with a bang, landing **390 commits** in the first few weeks of the year. This report highlights significant improvements in the Cupertino library, new widget capabilities like customizable Hero transitions, and expanded tooling support. We are also incredibly excited to welcome **12 new contributors** who have made their first mark on the project!

#### Framework & Material

*   **[#180100](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180100) Customizable Hero Transitions**
    The `Hero` widget now supports customizable animation curves, allowing for more expressive and unique shared element transitions.\
    *   Authored by [aaazlkm](https://github.com/aaazlkm) and reviewed by [Chun-Heng Tai](https://github.com/chunhtai), [Justin McCandless](https://github.com/justinmc), [Victor Sanni](https://github.com/victorsanni).

*   **[#181320](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181320), [#180273](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180273) Expansible Widget Enhancements**
    Added a `toggle` method to `ExpansibleController` and introduced comprehensive API samples and documentation for the `Expansible` widget, making it easier to use.
    *   Authored by [Kostia Sokolovskyi](https://github.com/ksokolovskyi) and [GowsikRaja](https://github.com/gowsikraja), reviewed by [Victor Sanni](https://github.com/victorsanni), [Chun-Heng Tai](https://github.com/chunhtai).

*   **[#177337](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/177337), [#180724](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180724) Cupertino Refinements**
    `CupertinoSheetRoute` now supports native-like scrolling and dragging. Additionally, `CupertinoFocusHalo` now supports superellipse shapes, matching Apple's design language more closely. 🍏
    *   Authored by [Mitchell Goodwin](https://github.com/MitchellGoodwin) and [Onnimanni Hannonen](https://github.com/O-Hannonen), reviewed by [Kate Lovett](https://github.com/Piinks), [Chun-Heng Tai](https://github.com/chunhtai), [Tong Mu](https://github.com/dkwingsmt).

*   **[#181074](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181074) DropdownMenu Flexibility**
    Reverted a breaking change to allow `DropdownMenu` to support non-nullable types more gracefully, restoring flexibility for developers.
    *   Authored by [August](https://github.com/Gustl22) and reviewed by [LongCatIsLooong](https://github.com/LongCatIsLooong), [Justin McCandless](https://github.com/justinmc).

*   **[#180577](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180577) BottomNavigationBar Accessibility**
    Added semantics labels to `BottomNavigationBar` items, improving the experience for users with screen readers. ♿
    *   Authored by [Lilian Cadiou](https://github.com/Lilian-C) and reviewed by [Kate Lovett](https://github.com/Piinks), [Hannah Jin](https://github.com/hannah-hyj).

*   **[#180667](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180667) CarouselView Control**
    Introduced `leadingIndex` to `CarouselController` and an `onItemChanged` callback to `CarouselView`, giving developers precise control over carousel state.
    *   Authored by [Mairramer](https://github.com/Mairramer) and reviewed by [Kate Lovett](https://github.com/Piinks), [Qun Cheng](https://github.com/QuncCccccc).

*   **[#177678](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/177678), [#180722](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180722) RawTooltip**
    Added `RawTooltip`, a lower-level widget with a smaller API surface, providing a foundation for building custom tooltips without the opinionated defaults of the material `Tooltip`.
    *   Authored by [Victor Sanni](https://github.com/victorsanni) and [Mohellebi abdessalem](https://github.com/AbdeMohlbi), reviewed by [Chun-Heng Tai](https://github.com/chunhtai), [Tong Mu](https://github.com/dkwingsmt), [Justin McCandless](https://github.com/justinmc), [Huy](https://github.com/huycozy).

#### Engine & Platform

*   **[#179219](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/179219) Android Display Corner Radii**
    Added support for querying display corner radii on Android, enabling UI adaptations for rounded screen corners.
    *   Authored by [Kostia Sokolovskyi](https://github.com/ksokolovskyi) and reviewed by [Justin McCandless](https://github.com/justinmc), [Matt Boetger](https://github.com/mboetger), [Mouad Debbar](https://github.com/mdebbar).

*   **[#180041](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180041) Reduced Motion on Web**
    Implemented support for `prefers-reduced-motion` on the web, automatically disabling animations when the user requests it.
    *   Authored by [David Iglesias](https://github.com/ditman) and reviewed by [Mouad Debbar](https://github.com/mdebbar).

*   **[#175805](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/175805) Web Template Variables**
    Added a `--web-define` flag to inject template variables into `index.html` during build time, simplifying environment configuration for web apps. 🌐
    *   Authored by [🧙‍♂️ O Mago do Flutter 🪄](https://github.com/ulisseshen) and reviewed by [Kevin Moore](https://github.com/kevmoo).

#### Tooling & Ecosystem

*   **[#180140](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180140) Widget Preview IDs**
    Registered DTD streams and services now include a UUID, improving the reliability of the Widget Preview feature in IDEs.
    *   Authored by [Ben Konyi](https://github.com/bkonyi) and reviewed by [Danny Tuppeny](https://github.com/DanTup), [Jessy Yameogo](https://github.com/jyameo).

*   **[#177888](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/177888) Auto-Generated ExportOptions**
    The Flutter tool now auto-generates `ExportOptions.plist` for manual iOS code signing, streamlining the build process for iOS developers.
    *   Authored by [Nour](https://github.com/MohammedTarigg) and reviewed by [Jenn Magder](https://github.com/magder).

*   **[#180689](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180689) Feature Flags Manifest Logic**
    Fixed logic to correctly locate the project root when searching for the FeatureFlags manifest, improving robustness of the tool.
    *   Authored by [Albert Wolszon](https://github.com/Albert221) and reviewed by [Andrew Marshall](https://github.com/planetmarshall).

#### First-time Contributors

A massive welcome to our **12 new contributors**! 🚀 Your contributions are vital to the health of the project.

*   [Augusto César Perin](https://github.com/augustocesarperin), for [#180824](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180824), fixing a crash in RawAutocomplete.
*   [David Bebawy](https://github.com/dbebawy), for [#180419](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180419), improving defensive programming in Windows embedding.
*   [Emmanuel](https://github.com/zemanux), for [#180074](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180074), adding `RenderSliver.getMaxPaintRect`.
*   [GowsikRaja](https://github.com/gowsikraja), for [#180273](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180273), creating docs and samples for the Expansible widget.
*   [Ikramul Hasan](https://github.com/ikramhasan), for [#181050](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181050), fixing ink highlight clipping in NavigationDrawer.
*   [Jon Mountjoy](https://github.com/jonmountjoy), for [#178643](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/178643), adding `RouteSettings` to `showCupertinoSheet`.
*   [Kishimoto](https://github.com/Koichi5), for [#180172](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180172), fixing a documentation typo.
*   [Lilian Cadiou](https://github.com/Lilian-C), for [#180577](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180577), enhancing BottomNavigationBar accessibility.
*   [Marijua](https://github.com/Enderjua), for [#181398](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181398), modernizing Typography code with Dart 3 features.
*   [Muhammad Saqib Javed](https://github.com/Saqib198), for [#180355](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180355), fixing iOS extended attribute removal.
*   [Nhan Nguyen](https://github.com/nathannewyen), for [#180326](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180326), fixing a docstring in the Drawer widget.
*   [🧙‍♂️ O Mago do Flutter 🪄](https://github.com/ulisseshen), for [#175805](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/175805), adding web build template variable support.

### January 24, 2026 to February 06, 2026

<details>

This week, 12 new contributors joined us for a total of 214 changes. We are marching towards 3.41.0 with significant macOS improvements, new Cupertino widgets, and better tooling!

### Framework & Widgets

*   **[#174695](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/174695) Cupertino apps get a native-style menu system with the new `CupertinoMenuAnchor` widget.** 🍎
    *   Authored by [davidhicks980](https://github.com/davidhicks980) and reviewed by [Tong Mu](https://github.com/dkwingsmt).

*   **[#176494](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/176494) `MenuAnchor` now supports Material Design 3 animations, making menus feel more responsive.** ✨
    *   Authored by [davidhicks980](https://github.com/davidhicks980) and reviewed by [Qun Cheng](https://github.com/QuncCccccc), [Tong Mu](https://github.com/dkwingsmt).

*   **[#181455](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181455) `AnimatedCrossFade` gains an `onEnd` callback, perfect for chaining animations.**
    *   Authored by [Kishan Rathore](https://github.com/rkishan516) and reviewed by [Victor Sanni](https://github.com/victorsanni), [Loïc Sharma](https://github.com/loic-sharma).

*   **[#177895](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/177895) `SizeTransition` now supports an `alignment` property, giving you more control over the animation origin.**
    *   Authored by [Ivone Djaja](https://github.com/IvoneDjaja) and reviewed by [Kate Lovett](https://github.com/Piinks), [Tong Mu](https://github.com/dkwingsmt), [Valentin Vignal](https://github.com/ValentinVignal), [Victor Sanni](https://github.com/victorsanni).

*   **[#177220](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/177220) Designers will love the new `RoundedSuperellipseInputBorder` for smoother, more organic shapes.** 🟢
    *   Authored by [Kishan Rathore](https://github.com/rkishan516) and reviewed by [Tong Mu](https://github.com/dkwingsmt), [Justin McCandless](https://github.com/justinmc).

*   **[#181373](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181373) `DropdownMenuFormField` now exposes more customization options like leading/trailing icons and focus nodes.**
    *   Authored by [August](https://github.com/Gustl22) and reviewed by [Qun Cheng](https://github.com/QuncCccccc), [Tong Mu](https://github.com/dkwingsmt).

*   **[#181475](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181475) `ThemeMode` now has cleaner `isDark`, `isLight`, and `isSystem` getters.**
    *   Authored by [Dmytro Turskyi](https://github.com/Turskyi) and reviewed by [Qun Cheng](https://github.com/QuncCccccc), [Victor Sanni](https://github.com/victorsanni).

*   **[#180752](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180752) Easily clear form errors without resetting values using the new `clearError` API on `FormFieldState`.**
    *   Authored by [Mairramer](https://github.com/Mairramer) and reviewed by [Justin McCandless](https://github.com/justinmc), [Kate Lovett](https://github.com/Piinks).

### Platform (macOS & Android)

*   **[#181769](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181769) macOS apps now support the Display P3 wide color gamut, ensuring vibrant and accurate colors.** 🎨
    *   Authored by [nmarci89](https://github.com/westito) and reviewed by [gaaclarke](https://github.com/gaaclarke), [Matej Knopp](https://github.com/knopp).

*   **[#180895](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180895) Native tooltip windows are now implemented on macOS.**
    *   Authored by [Matej Knopp](https://github.com/knopp) and reviewed by [Matthew Kosarek](https://github.com/mattkae), [Loïc Sharma](https://github.com/loic-sharma).

*   **[#181124](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181124) `FlutterFragment` now supports Android's predictive back gesture.** 🔙
    *   Authored by [moko256](https://github.com/moko256) and reviewed by [Justin McCandless](https://github.com/justinmc), [Gray Mackall](https://github.com/gmackall).

*   **[#180287](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180287) Fixed a macOS issue where old windows would persist after a hot restart.**
    *   Authored by [yim](https://github.com/yiiim) and reviewed by [Matej Knopp](https://github.com/knopp).

### Tooling & Ecosystem

*   **[#180531](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180531) The minimum required Xcode version is now 15, with Xcode 16 recommended.** 🛠️
    *   Authored by [Elijah Okoroh](https://github.com/okorohelijah) and reviewed by [Jenn Magder](https://github.com/jmagman), [Victoria Ashworth](https://github.com/vashworth).

*   **[#181533](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181533) Debug symbols are now split into separate `.dsym` files for native assets on macOS and iOS, reducing app size.**
    *   Authored by [Daco Harkes](https://github.com/dcharkes) and reviewed by [Ben Konyi](https://github.com/bkonyi), [Victoria Ashworth](https://github.com/vashworth).

*   **[#181884](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181884) The web hot reload flag is deprecated as it is now enabled by default.**
    *   Authored by [Nicholas Shahan](https://github.com/nshahan) and reviewed by [Mouad Debbar](https://github.com/mdebbar).

### First-time Contributors

We welcome 12 new contributors this week!

*   [Anish Tiwari](https://github.com/AnishTiwari5077), for [#180367](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180367), which fixed widget state handling in radio and switch list tiles.
*   [Ashok Narayan](https://github.com/ashoknarayan), for [#180469](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180469), which improved accessibility contrast for pre-test messages.
*   [Christoph Prenissl](https://github.com/chris-prenissl), for [#181082](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181082), which fixed a range slider issue.
*   [Dmytro Turskyi](https://github.com/Turskyi), for [#181475](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181475), which added convenience getters to `ThemeMode`.
*   [Eren Gun](https://github.com/Erengun), for [#181657](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181657), which cleaned up test dependencies.
*   [Giancarlo Cante](https://github.com/GiancarloCante), for [#180944](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180944), which renamed a parameter in `WidgetTesterCallback` for clarity.
*   [Ivone Djaja](https://github.com/IvoneDjaja), for [#177895](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/177895), which added an `alignment` property to `SizeTransition`.
*   [jingweicai](https://github.com/caijw), for [#181440](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181440), which optimized web font loading.
*   [Jonathan Reimer](https://github.com/jonathimer), for [#175587](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/175587), which added the Linux Foundation Health Score badge.
*   [nmarci89](https://github.com/westito), for [#181720](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181720), which fixed P3 color conversion logic.
*   [Nurda](https://github.com/yeltayev22), for [#181807](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181807), which cleaned up cross imports.
*   [Patrick Billingsley](https://github.com/patrickBillingsley), for [#181579](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181579), which propagated `MediaQueryData` to `OverlayPortal`.

### February 07, 2026 to February 20, 2026

<details>

A total of 211 changes were merged to the framework, engine, and packages since the last report.

**Framework**

*   [#180389](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180389) Expose TabBarScrollController for custom TabBar behavior. Developers can now pass a `TabBarScrollController` to the `TabBar` widget, allowing for more granular control over tab scrolling and programmatic synchronization with other scrollable components. 🖱️
    *   Authored by [Navaron Bracke](https://github.com/navaronbracke) and reviewed by [Tong Mu](https://github.com/dkwingsmt) and [Kate Lovett](https://github.com/Piinks).
*   [#180257](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180257) Customizable padding for Stepper widget. The `Stepper` widget now supports `headerPadding` and `contentPadding` properties, enabling developers to fine-tune the layout and spacing of their stepped processes for better visual alignment. 📏
    *   Authored by [Safwan Mamji](https://github.com/safwanidrees) and reviewed by [Tong Mu](https://github.com/dkwingsmt) and [Victor Sanni](https://github.com/victorsanni).
*   [#182527](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182527) Add RawTooltip.ignorePointer for hit-test control. A new `ignorePointer` property has been added to `RawTooltip`, giving developers the ability to control whether tooltips should be transparent to hit testing, which is particularly useful for overlay management. 🎯
    *   Authored by [Victor Sanni](https://github.com/victorsanni) and reviewed by [Tong Mu](https://github.com/dkwingsmt), [chunhtai](https://github.com/chunhtai), and [Navaron Bracke](https://github.com/navaronbracke).
*   [#181092](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181092) Introduce ScrollCacheExtent and fix shrinkwrap crashes. This change introduces the `ScrollCacheExtent` class to modernize how cache extents are specified and fixes a critical bug where `shrinkWrap: true` could cause applications to crash due to invalid cache calculations. 🛠️
    *   Authored by [chunhtai](https://github.com/chunhtai) and reviewed by [Kate Lovett](https://github.com/Piinks).
*   [#182391](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182391) Reliable status bar tap to scroll on iOS. This reland ensures that only the foreground `Scaffold` handles status bar tap events on iOS by performing a hit-test before scrolling, fixing a potential crash when multiple scaffolds are present. 📱
    *   Authored by [LongCatIsLooong](https://github.com/LongCatIsLooong) and reviewed by [chunhtai](https://github.com/chunhtai).
*   [#181882](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181882) Clearer error messages for color/decoration conflicts. Developers will now receive a much clearer and more helpful error message when providing both a `color` and `decoration` to a widget, explaining that one is a shorthand for the other and how to fix the conflict. 💡
    *   Authored by [Tong Mu](https://github.com/dkwingsmt) and reviewed by [Kate Lovett](https://github.com/Piinks).

**Web**

*   [#182079](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182079) Fix web-define flag in web builds. The `--web-define` flag is now correctly respected during `flutter build web`, ensuring that custom environment variables are properly substituted in `index.html` and `flutter_bootstrap.js`. 🌐
    *   Authored by [Michał Kucharski](https://github.com/mkucharski17) and reviewed by [Mouad Debbar](https://github.com/mdebbar) and [Ben Konyi](https://github.com/bkonyi).
*   [#180556](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180556) Improved accessibility for web form validation. Form validation errors on the web are now passed to screen readers using `aria-description`, ensuring that users of assistive technologies receive immediate feedback when form fields contain errors. ♿
    *   Authored by [zhongliugo](https://github.com/zhongliugo) and reviewed by [chunhtai](https://github.com/chunhtai) and [Mouad Debbar](https://github.com/mdebbar).

**Tool**

*   [#182392](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182392) Guided errors for SwiftPM and CocoaPods conflicts. The Flutter tool now provides specific, actionable instructions when a plugin conflict occurs between Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods, helping developers navigate the migration to SwiftPM. 📦
    *   Authored by [Victoria Ashworth](https://github.com/vashworth) and reviewed by [stuartmorgan-g](https://github.com/stuartmorgan-g).
*   [#181224](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181224) New command for Swift Package Add-to-App. An experimental `flutter build swift-package` command has been introduced to help developers create a Swift package for embedding Flutter apps into native iOS/macOS applications, simplifying the "Add-to-App" workflow. 🚀
    *   Authored by [Victoria Ashworth](https://github.com/vashworth) and reviewed by [stuartmorgan-g](https://github.com/stuartmorgan-g).
*   [#180098](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/180098) Discover running apps via the CLI. A new `flutter running-apps` command uses mDNS to discover and list all currently running Flutter applications on the network, making it easier to manage multiple debug sessions. 🔍
    *   Authored by [Jaime Wren](https://github.com/jwren) and reviewed by [Ben Konyi](https://github.com/bkonyi).
*   [#181515](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181515) Warnings for legacy iOS UIScene lifecycle. The tool now monitors iOS device logs for `UIScene` warnings and provides a guided message to help developers migrate their applications to the modern iOS lifecycle. ⚠️
    *   Authored by [Victoria Ashworth](https://github.com/vashworth) and reviewed by [Ben Konyi](https://github.com/bkonyi).

**Platform**

*   [#182113](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182113) Support for new Android CheckState APIs. Accessibility support on Android has been updated to use the latest `CheckState` APIs introduced in Android API 36, ensuring accurate state reporting for checkboxes and switches. 🤖
    *   Authored by [Hannah Jin](https://github.com/hannah-hyj) and reviewed by [chunhtai](https://github.com/chunhtai).
*   [#181251](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181251) Default SwiftPM support in new plugins. Newly created iOS and macOS plugins will now include support for both Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods by default, future-proofing new packages from the start. 🍏
    *   Authored by [Elijah Okoroh](https://github.com/okorohelijah) and reviewed by [Victoria Ashworth](https://github.com/vashworth).

**Engine**

*   [#182117](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182117) Extended uniform matrix support for Impeller. The Impeller rendering engine now supports `getUniformMatX` and `getUniformMatXArray` on desktop and mobile platforms, enabling more complex custom shaders and visual effects. 🎨
    *   Authored by [walley892](https://github.com/walley892) and reviewed by [gaaclarke](https://github.com/gaaclarke).

**First-time Contributors**

Welcome to 13 new first-time contributors!

- [Akhil George](https://github.com/akhil-ge0rge), for [#181658](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181658), which fixes an issue where `DateRangePicker` ignored `DatePickerTheme.dayShape`.
- [Akshat.Shukla](https://github.com/Akshat-Shuklaaa), for [#182461](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182461), which fixed grammar in the animation library documentation.
- [Divyansh Shah](https://github.com/crackedhandle), for [#182051](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182051), which improved testing documentation.
- [Dominique Martinet](https://github.com/martinetd), for [#181984](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181984), which fixed binary stripping in certain build targets.
- [EricApostal](https://github.com/EricApostal), for [#182273](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182273), which improved robustness of web define variable handling.

- [qian](https://github.com/HuQian), for [#182057](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182057), which fixed build failures for Wayland-only platforms.
- [Ricky van den berg](https://github.com/RickyvdBerg), for [#181966](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181966), which fixed a memory leak in Impeller's Vulkan backend.

- [Michał Kucharski](https://github.com/mkucharski17), for [#182079](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182079), which fixed the `--web-define` flag in web builds.

### February 21, 2026 to February 27, 2026

<details>

This week saw 182 changes land in the Flutter repository, including several highly requested features and developer experience improvements that are expected to be part of the upcoming 3.34.0 release. We are especially excited to welcome 11 first-time contributors to the project!

#### Framework

*   **[#181795](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/181795) Fix Text.semanticsIdentifier being absorbed by ancestor nodes**
    *   Authored by [zhongliugo](https://github.com/zhongliugo) and reviewed by [Chun-Heng Tai](https://github.com/chunhtai).
    *   Ensures `Text` widgets with a `semanticsIdentifier` create their own semantic element instead of being absorbed by ancestors like `Dialog`, improving accessibility auditing.

### April 10, 2026 to April 17, 2026

This week, the Flutter community landed 107 changes, moving us toward the upcoming 3.44.0 release. We are thrilled to welcome 4 first-time contributors! This week's highlights include enhancements to animation styling, deep platform integrations for multi-window applications, and a significant fix for desktop icon tree shaking.

### Framework & Widgets
- **[#182333](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/182333) Expanded AnimationStyle capabilities**
  `AnimationStyle` now supports a `merge()` method for better parity with other styling APIs, and the `lerp()` method has been improved to provide more accurate interpolation during transitions. 🎥
  *   Authored by [Nate Wilson](https://github.com/nate-thegrate) and reviewed by [Navaron Bracke](https://github.com/navaronbracke), [Victor Sanni](https://github.com/victorsanni), [Justin McCandless](https://github.com/justinmc).
- **[#184788](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/184788) Dismissible context menus via keyboard**
  Users can now dismiss the context menu in a `SelectableRegion` using the "Escape" key, improving the accessibility and responsiveness of keyboard-driven workflows. ⌨️
  *   Authored by [Renzo Olivares](https://github.com/Renzo-Olivares) and reviewed by [Loïc Sharma](https://github.com/loic-sharma), [chunhtai](https://github.com/chunhtai).

### Accessibility
- **[#179690](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/179690) Improved semantics for SliverResizingHeader**
  Accessibility is enhanced for `SliverResizingHeader` by ensuring that semantic focus is correctly managed as the header resizes, providing a smoother experience for screen reader users. 🔊
  *   Authored by [Emmanuel](https://github.com/zemanux) and reviewed by [Renzo Olivares](https://github.com/Renzo-Olivares), [Kate Lovett](https://github.com/Piinks).

### Tooling & Platform
- **[#184662](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/184662) Native handles for multi-window API**
  Multi-window support is now more powerful as developers can now access underlying platform handles (`NSWindow`, `HWND`, `GtkWindow`), enabling deep, platform-specific window customizations. 🖼️
  *   Authored by [Matej Knopp](https://github.com/knopp) and reviewed by [Robert Ancell](https://github.com/robert-ancell), [Matthew Kosarek](https://github.com/mattkae), [Loïc Sharma](https://github.com/loic-sharma).
- **[#184249](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/184249) Fixed desktop icon tree shaking**
  Desktop applications get a size reduction as icon tree shaking is now correctly enabled for desktop builds, reducing the `MaterialIcons` font size from several megabytes to just a few kilobytes. 🪚
  *   Authored by [Balázs R](https://github.com/nvi9) and reviewed by [Lau Ching Jun](https://github.com/chingjun), [Ben Konyi](https://github.com/bkonyi).
- **[#183455](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/183455) Simplified package cleaning with --include-example**
  Package developers can now clean both their main package and its example project in a single step using the new `--include-example` flag for `flutter clean`. 🧹
  *   Authored by [Anurag Devanapally](https://github.com/andeart) and reviewed by [Ben Konyi](https://github.com/bkonyi), [Jenn Magder](https://github.com/jmagman).
- **[#184335](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/184335) Flexible framework naming on macOS/iOS**
  Platform integration on Apple platforms is more flexible with new support for period characters in iOS and macOS framework names. 📦
  *   Authored by [tjoengCRC](https://github.com/tjoengCRC) and reviewed by [Daco Harkes](https://github.com/dcharkes), [hellohuanlin](https://github.com/hellohuanlin), [LouiseHsu](https://github.com/LouiseHsu).

### Engine & Graphics
- **[#184913](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/184913) Precise Impeller morphology filters**
  Impeller's morphology filters are now more accurate, fixing a visual glitch where dilation and erosion could be asymmetric due to fractional pixel truncation. 📐
  *   Authored by [arcashka](https://github.com/arcashka) and reviewed by [walley892](https://github.com/walley892), [Jim Graham](https://github.com/flar).
